title: Lenox Nutcracker Ballet Hors d'Oeuvres Tray

comparisons.notes: Lenox's own listing for the Nutcracker Ballet hors d'oeuvres tray (model 897886), in stock, new

writeup: Lenox's Nutcracker Ballet hors d'oeuvres tray is a 13 x 6.75 inch porcelain serving tray with whimsical nutcracker illustrations, peppermint details and gold accents. It's dishwasher safe and new. Woot has it for $12.99 while Lenox's own store lists it at $45.95, and quantities are limited to 5 per customer.
